'''0.18b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that updated the splash screen and fixed some security-related bugs.

==Changelog==
* New splash screen

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed a bug that caused the player to fall through the ground
* Rendering optimization
* Fixed a bug in the firewall rules
* Fixed some bugs to do with the sound
* Fixed bug with Antivirus
